name: Tadashii Koto
source:
As the snow fell silently, Yoshino and Kyouichi returned home to find their somewhat eccentric cousin waiting for them.
"Hey, what exactly is the right thing to do?"
The question posed to their cousin was lost in the snow.
This is a sequel to "Futatsu no Michi".
